description: Capability for the standalone dynamic-island settings window (created lazily by Rust, see island_settings_window.rs; custom commands like open_island_settings_window / island_settings_doc are not ACL-gated). The window is a 920x660 transparent frameless card whose 64px title bar is drawn by the page: start-dragging backs the drag-anywhere header, allow-close backs the close button / Esc path (the page's fallback calls getCurrentWindow().close(), the lib.rs CloseRequested handler then prevents the default close and destroys the window; the custom island_settings_window_hide command destroys it as well). Closing now destroys the window and releases its WebView2 renderer, so allow-hide is kept only as a legacy fallback permission. dialog open/save back the settings import/export pickers and path browse buttons. opener backs the About page's repository / issues / license links (openUrl, with a window.open fallback outside Tauri). No minimize/maximize here: this page has no such buttons.
